notes.title: ENCODYA Update v1.1 (language update) has been released!
notes.content:
Cyberpunk-Fans! 
Thanks to the technology of 2062, and your valuable feedback for sure, we have released another update for ENCODYA. This time adding three localizations! 

[h1]Three new languages added[/h1]
[list][*] [b]Added Simplified Chinese localization[/b]
[*] [b]Added Japanese localization[/b]
[*] [b]Added Korean localization[/b][/list]

[h3]Improvemnets & Tweaks[/h3]
[list][*] Improved some of the German localization
[*] Reduced size and opacity of the FPS counter
[*] Removed from Inventory some items when going back to reality in the epilogue[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed few bugs with the Missions Tracker interface
[*] Fixed few bugs when loading on certain locations
[*] Fixed a bug with Traffic Bot about Police Permission if starting the quest with Tina and finishing it with Sam and viceversa
[*] Polished few bugs related with hotspots[/list]

notes.title: ENCODYA Update v1.08 has been released!
notes.content:
Cyberpunk-Fans! 
Thanks to the technology of 2062, and your valuable feedback for sure, we have released another small update for ENCODYA.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed the bug (known issue) that made the cursor disappear, after using load/continue on some locations 
[*] Fixed some visual glitches with Russian font.
[*] Fixed a bug that restored the Highlight Circles on Load.
[*] Fixed a bug with Missing Database persons overlapping 
[*] Moved a collectable item a bit, to be more noticeable.
[*] Fixed a wrong interaction with the Shelter after returning to it.[/list]

[h3]Misc.[/h3]
[list][*] Added more people walking around the streets 
[*] Improved Russian translation 
[*] Adjusted a few names in the credits[/list]

[h3]Known Issues v1.08:[/h3]
[list][*] Currently the font size of the the Missions Tracker (small menu activated with the yellow "!" icon top right corner) is increased. Due to this, in Italian and German, the text of some Missions is cut, if the text is too long.[/list]

notes.title: ENCODYA - First small update released!
notes.content:
Cyberpunk-Fans! 
Thanks to the technology of 2062, we can release the first small update this quickly. 

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a bug about Blixy: 'Look At' and 'Pick' interactions are now disabled after getting the keys.
[*]Fixed a bug about 'Traffic Bot' giving you twice the 'Police Permission'.
[*]Fixed a bug about reactivating the UI when quitting the very last Terminal.
[*]Fixed a small bug, which caused the Russian font not displaying buttons in the Main Menu.
[*]Fixed a small bug on the 'Total Game Played' at the very end.[/list]

[h1]Misc.[/h1]
[list][*]Disabled Mac Retina Support that might cause slow performance on Mac.[/list]


[h1]Thank you for your ongoing support for ENCODYA![/h1]
